Requires a video with audio of the engine operating at temperature.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or low compression
risks.proof: A video showing a compression test on all cylinders.
risks.if_unproven: as a core requiring a full rebuild

risks.proof: A video of the transmission being shifted through gears or a diagnostic scan of the TCU.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional unit for parts only

risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code and serial number stamped on the engine block.
An endoscope photo showing the internal honeycomb structure of the converters.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine model/serial number stamped on the block.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
Close-up photos of the wiring harness connectors to check for cuts or corrosion.
Photos of the engine oil dipstick and under the oil filler cap to check for sludge.
response.reason: The specific brand and model of the engine are not identified in the report, which is essential for determining any market value. Without the engine code, compatibility and base pricing cannot be established.
